planner.question: Can existential evidence certify absence from a circuit range using only polynomially many bit queries in the original input length?
planner.strategy: Construct circuits interpolating arbitrary small samples; derive transcript indistinguishability.
planner.alternative: Extend to bounded-randomness verification and compute exact finite certificate complexity.
planner.stop_rule: Do not infer unrestricted NP nonmembership or SAT lower bounds from an oracle-access model.
literature_leads: Prior MathOS circuit range avoidance; elementary Boolean decision-tree interpolation. No novelty claim.

construct.claim: Every arbitrary q-point labeling admits a circuit of at most max(0,2q-3) gates; sound oracle certificates of missing words must inspect more than floor((s+3)/2) bits.
construct.scope: All 16 binary Boolean gates, free constants, explicit prefix; adaptive bit-query verifier with arbitrary certificate and perfect soundness.
construct.derivation: Split samples into a full binary tree; compile each node with one or three gates; interpolate the accepting transcript to an easy word.
unresolved_steps: NP membership of a fixed hard language; certification beyond individual word queries.
candidate_tests: All nonempty partial labelings on up to three inputs; compile and replay gate output.

alternative.claim: Bounded-randomness verifiers must satisfy q*(floor(beta*2^r)+1)>floor((s+3)/2); exact finite certificate sizes are computed by subset projections.
alternative.scope: Fixed certificate, at most q queries per tape, r unbiased bits, completeness alpha>beta soundness.
alternative.derivation: Select more accepting tapes than the soundness permits; interpolate their union; replay same certificate on easy word.
unresolved_steps: Unrestricted randomness and general explicit-word or bit-membership certificate systems.
candidate_tests: Exact absent-word minimum certificate size histograms and budget controls.

objections: Bit-query access is a restricted model.
Polynomial in explicit prefix length differs from polynomial in n.
NP bit-membership need not certify global range absence.
No hardness claim for circuit minimization.
counterexample_candidates: Small sample always extends to an easy word; adaptive verification and arbitrary certificate do not prevent transcript replay.
critic.equivalence_audit: Exact sample interpolation and identical transcript argument, distinct from global NP verification.
critic.barrier_audit: Restricted oracle certificate lower bound only; no unrestricted complexity separation.
